verdict.rationale: LegalOS documents an O-1A eligibility checker that gives a personalized assessment from immigration attorneys, and its O-1 page promises evidence mapped to O-1 criteria with attorney review before filing. It does not document how the evaluation works, such as which USCIS criteria are scored, how evidence is weighed, or what the assessment output contains. missing for 10: a documented assessment methodology against the specific O-1A criteria, a sample or description of the structured assessment output, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can get a structured O-1A qualification assessment — the provider documents how it evaluates my extraordinary-ability evidence against the USCIS criteria before anything is filed

citations.quote: Answer a few questions and get a personalized assessment from immigration attorneys.
Every petition is reviewed by a licensed immigration attorney before filing.
